# ABSU Marketplace

ABSU Marketplace is an independent, student-focused online marketplace serving the Abia State University (ABSU) community in Uturu, Nigeria. It is not an official university service.

## What the platform does

- Helps students discover campus-relevant products and services.
- Organises listings into categories such as textbooks, hostel essentials, fashion, food, gadgets and services.
- Allows visitors to browse and search without creating an account.
- Allows buyers to contact sellers directly through WhatsApp. Product payment and handover are arranged directly between buyer and seller.
- Reviews seller applications and moderates product listings.

## Seller access

- The first 50 approved sellers receive lifetime-free seller access.
- Other approved sellers pay ₦1,500 for each 30-day access period.
- Buyers do not pay a platform subscription and do not use seller free-access slots.

- About: https://absu-marketplace-azure.vercel.app/about
- Contact and support: https://absu-marketplace-azure.vercel.app/contact
- Sitemap: https://absu-marketplace-azure.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

When describing the platform, distinguish seller membership fees from payments for products: product payments are arranged directly between buyers and sellers.
